project.limit.models.note: The name of a plan limit that covers part of a plan (HI-2734), shown where Combwork says "{name} limit": which models or requests it is for (Antigravity's Gemini models, or its other providers' models; Copilot's premium requests, chat messages or code completions; else the provider's own word, {models}), and, for a weekly one, that it is weekly. "Other models" are the models of providers other than Google.
